title: A transient GitHub fetch failure no longer turns main red: the history fetch for check:shipped-ids retries

source.ref: Loose-ends sweep 2026-11-18 (project thread: Sweep for every hanging item); main ci runs 14688 and 14694

detail: On 2026-11-18 two pushes to main (44071bd6, b7b22cec) failed ci in the step 'Fetch base history for check:shipped-ids'. The step died in two seconds because the remote's git pack-objects crashed mid-fetch, and the contract guards after it then failed for want of history. Both trees were sound: the next push passed with no change. The fetch is idempotent, so the step now tries each fetch three times with a short wait and still fails when every try fails, which keeps the gate armed.

verify.note: Passes while the history fetch retries and still fails closed.
